title: On an iPhone, progress photos and exercise clips would go to the member's iCloud backup even with photo backup left off
what: Progress photos and a member's own exercise photos and clips are kept in the app's main storage folder. On Android only a chosen copy folder is backed up, so the 'Include photos in my backup' switch, off by default, decides what leaves the phone. On an iPhone that same folder is copied to iCloud backup automatically unless the app marks it to stay out, and nothing does. The switch would then do nothing, and every photo would leave the phone while the member was told it stays.
expected: Before the iPhone app ships, photos and clips stay out of iCloud backup unless the member turns photo backup on, and the switch and privacy words match what the iPhone really does.
how_often: every iPhone backup once the iPhone app ships
fix_line: Mark the photo and clip folders to stay out of iCloud backup on iPhone, and make the backup switch work there or hide it

items.reason: Camera asked only when tapped; gallery, import and saves go through the phone's own picker and share list; no ads, billing or WhatsApp here. The AI finish note (behind the coach switch) has no health safety rule, same fault as the coach finding. Hevy link folder repair is the Hevy-link fault. Data safety form itself was not in the inputs, so whether it lists the Groq note could not be compared.
Photos would go to iCloud backup; camera and photos reasons talk about meals, not exercise clips (existing finding).

Import uses the open-source spreadsheet package with no licence notice shown, and library pictures whose source record is incomplete (existing findings). Hevy and Strong names are only used to say where a file comes from.
